data.exact_reserve_text: The 2015 and 2016 years of account have seen positive claims experience and the RITC of 2015 has also resulted in a release of reserves, However, the loss experience has been worse than anticipated for the 2017 year of account due to the catastrophe events in the second half of the year. Reserves have been established in respect of Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria (Gross: GBP 74,828k, Net: GBP 23,040k) and Californian wildfires (Gross: GBP 7,970k, Net: GBP 7,362k) in October and December.

prior_year_events.impact_description: RITC yielded a profit for the Syndicate of GBP 49m as the premium was below the booked reserves; liabilities for 2008-2015 were transferred to Syndicate 2008.
Revision to estimated unallocated loss adjustment expenses (ULAE) resulted in an overall release of GBP 7.8m in 2017; GBP 10.727k release was attributed to 2015 and prior.

named_events.loss_description: Reserves have been established in respect of Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria (Gross: GBP 74,828k, Net: GBP 23,040k).
Reserves have been established in respect of Californian wildfires (Gross: GBP 7,970k, Net: GBP 7,362k) in October and December.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the Syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 621.9m. During 2017 prior underwriting years (notably 2015 and 2016) produced favourable claims development and the 2015 year was closed via a reinsurance-to-close (RITC) which yielded a profit of GBP 49m leading to a material release of prior reserves; a recalibration of ULAE yielded a further release attributed to prior years. Offsetting some of this prior-year improvement, 2017 catastrophe events (Hurricanes Harvey/Irma/Maria and Californian wildfires) required the establishment of explicit gross reserves (gross ~GBP 82.8m) in the second half of the year.

data.data_quality_notes: A precise gross prior-year development figure (gross movement for years <=2015) could not be unambiguously extracted. The report states clear qualitative releases (positive claims experience, 2015 RITC profit GBP 49m, ULAE recalibration releasing GBP 17.8m total with GBP 10.727m attributed to 2015 & prior) and also shows a gross claims development triangle (pages 21-22) but the triangle layout in the parsed text is difficult to align unambiguously to columns and the 2015 RITC transaction distorts comparisons. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is returned as null rather than risking an incorrect gross-signed number. The triangle (gross) is present and included in _claims_triangle for secondary analysis.
